feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Snow warning in place for parts of UK this morning
articles.summary: A yellow alert for snow is in force for parts of the UK, with forecasters warning of possible travel disruption.

articles.title: Americans urged to 'keep a low profile' in UK amid terror threat over festive season
articles.summary: US citizens in the UK have been warned to "keep a low profile" and remain vigilant to potential terror attacks during the festive period.

articles.title: Water companies told to act over fears drought will extend into next year
articles.summary: Water firms have been told to do more over fears the current drought will extend into next year.

articles.title: British artist Raye leads Grammy nominations with 11 nods
articles.summary: British singer Raye is the most nominated artist for the upcoming Grammy Awards in 2027, leading the field with 11 nods.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson named as new James Bond
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson has been confirmed as the new James Bond.

articles.title: Man in court after two killed in police chase collision
articles.summary: A man charged with causing death by dangerous driving after two people were killed when a car being chased by police collided with their vehicle has appeared in court.

articles.title: Government accused of 'complacency' over 'catastrophic' security risks to UK
articles.summary: Andy Burnham's government appears "complacent" about the potential for "catastrophic risks" to the UK - and the country is underprepared, an influential committee of peers has warned.
